Poisoned.note: On the player the Pukka chose tonight.

Dead.note: On last night's poisoned player when they die.

setupPrep.none: its tokens mark what a player chooses at night, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: Placed on a new choice each night.

reminderPlaceholders.note: Tonight's target is poisoned; last night's target dies and becomes healthy.

full.text: The Pukka chooses a player: mark them *POISONED*. The player poisoned last night dies: mark them *DEAD* and remove their *POISONED*.
full.reason: Says the new target is poisoned and last night’s target dies, then is healthy.
